note: Fixed reference corpus for the latency harness (docs/seo/tasks/01-measurement-harness.md §1). Every published latency figure is measured against THIS list at THIS version. Changing a sentence changes the numbers, so edits bump the version and invalidate prior runs — they are not comparable across versions. Traits mark why each sentence is in the set; they are what make the tail interesting rather than the mean.

traits.subordinate: Long sentence with an embedded clause. Forces the pipeline to buffer more before it can emit — the dominant cost on verb-final target languages.
traits.numeric: Numbers, dates, currencies. Cheap to mistranslate, expensive to get wrong in a negotiation.
traits.propernoun: Proper nouns and product names, which must survive untranslated.
traits.register: Politeness or directness that has to carry across, not just the literal content.
